description: This Java class defines an Android activity (WearPermissionRequestActivity) that presents a permission rationale screen to the user for accessing storage. It handles user responses to approve or deny permission requests and communicates the result back to the calling activity.

classes.name: WearPermissionRequestActivity
classes.description: An Android AppCompatActivity that displays a permission request UI for storage access and handles user responses to grant or deny permission.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to display the permission request UI.

methods.name: onClickApprovePermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles user's approval action, sets the result to RESULT_OK and finishes the activity.

methods.name: onClickDenyPermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles user's denial action, sets the result to RESULT_CANCELED and finishes the activity.
